name: Black Coffee
description: The global house music icon Black Coffee brings his soulful, hypnotic sound to the coast. This is set to be one of the biggest electronic music events of the season, right on the beach in Matosinhos.
longDescription:
Black Coffee, the Grammy Award-winning South African DJ and producer, is set to perform on the Matosinhos coastline. Known for his distinctive blend of deep house, soulful melodies, and African rhythms, he has established himself as a prominent figure in electronic music globally. This event marks a significant appearance for the artist in the Porto region, drawing an international audience.

Attendees can expect an evening of sophisticated electronic music in an open-air setting. The event takes place at Praia do Aterro, offering a coastal backdrop for the performance. The atmosphere is anticipated to be energetic, catering to fans of house music and those seeking a large-scale outdoor concert experience. The duration of the performance will be typical for a headline DJ set.

Tickets for this nightlife event vary in price and are available for purchase. Praia do Aterro in Matosinhos is accessible via public transport, with bus routes serving the coastal area. Specific bus numbers and stops can be found on local transport websites. The venue is an outdoor beach location.
